[image: Ending U.S. Complicity in Gaza illustration] Ending U.S. Complicity in Gaza Independent UN experts, genocide scholars, and human rights organizations, including Israeli ones, have concluded Israel has committed genocidal acts in Gaza. Lydia would vote against continued military aid until compliance is independently verified, and will push to enforce existing human rights law, force a real congressional vote on arms sales, and oppose merging U.S. and Israeli military supply chains. Read More

[image: Ending the War in Iran illustration] Ending the War in Iran The U.S. launched airstrikes on Iran without congressional authorization in February 2026. Congress passed a symbolic concurrent resolution against the war, then killed the joint resolution that would have actually carried legal force, the very next day, after direct White House pressure. Lydia will vote for binding legislation, oppose further war funding without authorization, and close the ceasefire loophole the administration is using to sidestep the law. Read More

[image: Restoring Congress's War Power illustration] Restoring Congress's War Power The Constitution gives the power to declare war to Congress, not the President. Lydia will vote for binding resolutions to end unauthorized hostilities, oppose treating old AUMFs as permanent justification for new conflicts, and push Congress to reclaim its constitutional role regardless of who holds the presidency. Read More

[image: Restoring Fair Military Service Standards illustration] Restoring Fair Military Service Standards Whether a transgender American can serve in the military currently depends on which court is ruling and which administration is in office. A federal appeals court found in June 2026 that discharging currently serving transgender troops was unconstitutional, but the ban on new enlistment remains in place pending a Supreme Court appeal. Lydia will push to write military service eligibility into law, so eligibility is decided by fitness for duty, not gender identity or executive order. Read More
